broadSnapshot.scope: Reproduced historical Gen6 wordfreq/static snapshot; includes entire production static union. It is a bounded audit snapshot, not a claim of inventory equality with every live Wikidata entry.
broadSnapshot.policy: Recognition presence does not constitute target/editorial approval; newly detected complete covers require exact review.

boards.decision: Only explicitly published approved solutionSets may be accepted. All broad candidates remain recorded for review; do not silently replace or drop reward slot.
